papers.title: High-Dimensional Continuous Control Using Generalized Advantage Estimation
papers.authors: John Schulman, Philipp Moritz, Sergey Levine, Michael Jordan, Pieter Abbeel
papers.summary: 用指数加权的 TD 残差估计优势，通过 λ 控制偏差与方差。
papers.summary_en: Estimate advantages from exponentially weighted TD residuals, with lambda controlling the bias–variance tradeoff.
papers.scope: 实现 GAE 的反向递推和 episode 边界处理。
papers.scope_en: Implement the backward GAE recurrence and episode boundary handling.

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
papers.authors: John Schulman, Filip Wolski, Prafulla Dhariwal, Alec Radford, Oleg Klimov
papers.summary: 在策略目标中截断概率比，限制过大的策略更新带来的收益。
papers.summary_en: Clip probability ratios in the policy objective to limit the incentive for excessively large updates.
papers.scope: 实现 clipped surrogate 及其梯度行为；价值损失、归一化和统计代码已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the clipped surrogate and its gradient behavior; value loss, normalization, and diagnostics are supplied.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.authors: Rafael Rafailov, Archit Sharma, Eric Mitchell, Stefano Ermon, Christopher D. Manning, Chelsea Finn
papers.summary: 将偏好对上的隐式奖励差转化为直接优化语言模型的分类目标。
papers.summary_en: Turn the implicit reward margin of preference pairs into an objective that directly optimizes a language model.
papers.scope: 实现偏好损失与隐式奖励；token 对齐和序列 log-prob 计算已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the preference loss and implicit rewards; token alignment and sequence log-probability calculation are supplied.

papers.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
papers.authors: Zhihong Shao, Peiyi Wang, Qihao Zhu, Runxin Xu, Junxiao Song, Xiao Bi, Haowei Zhang, Mingchuan Zhang, Y. K. Li, Y. Wu, Daya Guo
papers.summary: 使用同一问题的一组回答构造相对优势，并通过 GRPO 目标更新策略。
papers.summary_en: Construct relative advantages from a group of responses to the same prompt and update the policy with the GRPO objective.
papers.scope: 选取论文的 GRPO 模块：组内相对优势、截断目标和回答级聚合。
papers.scope_en: Focus on the paper's GRPO module: group-relative advantages, clipped objectives, and response-level aggregation.

papers.title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective
papers.authors: Zichen Liu, Changyu Chen, Wenjun Li, Penghui Qi, Tianyu Pang, Chao Du, Wee Sun Lee, Min Lin
papers.summary: 分析 GRPO 的长度与难度偏差，并调整优势缩放和损失归一化。
papers.summary_en: Analyze length and difficulty biases in GRPO and adjust advantage scaling and loss normalization.
papers.scope: 实现去除组内标准差缩放与固定生成长度归一化这两处修正。
papers.scope_en: Implement two corrections: remove group standard-deviation scaling and normalize by a fixed generation budget.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.authors: Jonathan Ho, Ajay Jain, Pieter Abbeel
papers.summary: 用逐步加噪的前向过程和学习去噪的反向过程构造生成模型。
papers.summary_en: Build a generative model from a forward noising process and a learned reverse denoising process.
papers.scope: 实现闭式前向加噪，以及高斯后验和 epsilon 参数化的反向一步；调度器与采样循环已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement closed-form forward noising, the Gaussian posterior, and an epsilon-parameterized reverse step; schedules and sampling loops are supplied.

papers.title: Progressive Distillation for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
papers.summary: 把教师的两步确定性更新蒸馏为学生的一步更新，逐轮减少采样步数。
papers.summary_en: Distill two deterministic teacher steps into one student step, progressively reducing the sampling budget.
papers.scope: 先实现 v 参数化转换，再推导两步教师到一步学生的蒸馏目标并验证更新。
papers.scope_en: Implement v-parameterization conversions, then derive and validate the two-teacher-step to one-student-step distillation target.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.authors: Jiaming Song, Chenlin Meng, Stefano Ermon
papers.summary: 使用非马尔可夫采样更新实现跳步生成，并以 eta 控制随机性。
papers.summary_en: Use a non-Markovian sampling update to skip timesteps, with eta controlling stochasticity.
papers.scope: 实现 DDIM 单步更新和干净端点；时间步选择、循环与反演探索代码已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the DDIM update and clean endpoint; timestep selection, loops, and inversion exploration code are supplied.

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Yaron Lipman, Ricky T. Q. Chen, Heli Ben-Hamu, Maximilian Nickel, Matt Le
papers.summary: 通过回归条件概率路径的速度场学习连续生成流。
papers.summary_en: Learn a continuous generative flow by regressing the velocity field of conditional probability paths.
papers.scope: 实现条件路径、目标速度和 CFM 回归损失；时间采样、Euler 积分和训练辅助代码已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the conditional path, target velocity, and CFM regression loss; time sampling, Euler integration, and training helpers are supplied.

papers.title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization
papers.summary: 在回答级别构造长度归一化的重要性比率，再截断策略目标。
papers.summary_en: Construct length-normalized sequence importance ratios and clip the policy objective at the response level.
papers.scope: 实现序列概率比与 GSPO 损失，验证掩码、截断区域和梯度。
papers.scope_en: Implement sequence ratios and the GSPO loss; test masking, clipping regions, and gradients.

papers.title: On-policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes
papers.summary: 在学生自己生成的前缀上查询教师分布，减少训练与生成时的分布偏移。
papers.summary_en: Query the teacher on student-generated prefixes to reduce the mismatch between training and generation.
papers.scope: 实现学生 rollout 和全词表散度；在小型自回归模型上验证。OPD 在此指 on-policy distillation。
papers.scope_en: Implement student rollouts and full-vocabulary divergence in a tiny autoregressive model. OPD here means on-policy distillation.

papers.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
papers.summary: 通过动态保留有效回答组、非对称截断和 token 级聚合改进策略优化。
papers.summary_en: Improve policy optimization with informative-group filtering, asymmetric clipping, and token-level aggregation.
papers.scope: 实现组筛选与 token 级目标；采样系统和分布式训练不在本模块范围。
papers.scope_en: Implement group filtering and the token-level objective; sampling infrastructure and distributed training are outside this module.

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: 冻结预训练权重，以低秩矩阵乘积学习增量。
papers.summary_en: Freeze pretrained weights and learn an update through a low-rank matrix product.
papers.scope: 实现低秩增量和线性前向，验证冻结边界及小型回归学习。
papers.scope_en: Implement the low-rank update and linear forward pass; verify frozen parameters and a small regression experiment.

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.authors: Tim Dettmers, Artidoro Pagnoni, Ari Holtzman, Luke Zettlemoyer
papers.summary: 在量化的冻结基座上训练低秩适配器，以减少微调内存。
papers.summary_en: Train low-rank adapters on a quantized frozen base to reduce fine-tuning memory.
papers.scope: 实现分块 NF4 量化、反量化与适配器前向；不模拟双重量化或分页优化器。
papers.scope_en: Implement blockwise NF4 quantization, dequantization, and adapter forward; double quantization and paged optimizers are outside this exercise.

papers.title: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Zhengyang Geng, Mingyang Deng, Xingjian Bai, J. Zico Kolter, Kaiming He
papers.summary: 用瞬时速度和平均速度之间的恒等式学习区间流，以一步生成样本。
papers.summary_en: Learn an interval flow using the identity between instantaneous and average velocities for one-step generation.
papers.scope: 实现平均流的 JVP 目标和梯度边界，并运行小型生成实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement the average-flow JVP target and gradient boundaries, then run a small generative experiment.

papers.title: Back to Basics: Let Denoising Generative Models Denoise
papers.summary: 直接预测干净数据，在不同预测空间和损失空间之间显式转换。
papers.summary_en: Predict clean data directly and explicitly convert between prediction and loss spaces.
papers.scope: 实现 x-prediction 到速度的转换与去噪目标，使用论文启发的低维流形嵌入实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement data-to-velocity conversion and the denoising objective with a paper-derived embedded-manifold experiment.

papers.title: Generative Modeling via Drifting
papers.authors: Mingyang Deng, He Li, Tianhong Li, Yilun Du, Kaiming He
papers.summary: 构造吸引真实样本、排斥生成样本的漂移场，并用停止梯度的目标训练生成器。
papers.summary_en: Construct a drifting field that attracts real samples and repels generated samples, then train a generator against a stopped-gradient target.
papers.scope: 实现漂移场与停止梯度损失，在小型二维分布上验证生成器行为。
papers.scope_en: Implement the drifting field and stopped-gradient loss, and verify generator behavior on a small two-dimensional distribution.

papers.title: One-step Diffusion with Distribution Matching Distillation
papers.authors: Tianwei Yin, Michaël Gharbi, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Fredo Durand, William T. Freeman, Taesung Park
papers.summary: 用真实分布和生成分布的 score 差构造生成器的分布匹配更新。
papers.summary_en: Use the score difference between real and generated distributions to construct a distribution-matching generator update.
papers.scope: 实现 score 差目标与配对回归项，用解析双峰分布检查模式覆盖。
papers.scope_en: Implement the score-difference target and paired regression term; inspect mode coverage using an analytic bimodal distribution.

papers.title: Improved Distribution Matching Distillation for Fast Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Tianwei Yin, Michaël Gharbi, Taesung Park, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Fredo Durand, William T. Freeman
papers.summary: 通过更快的假 score 更新和对抗辅助训练，去除 DMD 的配对回归要求。
papers.summary_en: Remove DMD's paired-regression requirement using faster fake-score updates and adversarial auxiliary training.
papers.scope: 实现双时间尺度更新与辅助目标，在小型实验中验证参数更新边界。
papers.scope_en: Implement two-timescale updates and auxiliary objectives; verify parameter-update boundaries in a small experiment.

papers.title: Consistency Models
papers.authors: Yang Song, Prafulla Dhariwal, Mark Chen, Ilya Sutskever
papers.summary: 让同一生成轨迹上的不同噪声状态映射到一致的干净端点。
papers.summary_en: Map noisy states along the same generative trajectory to a consistent clean endpoint.
papers.scope: 实现边界参数化和相邻时刻的一致性蒸馏损失。
papers.scope_en: Implement the boundary parameterization and adjacent-time consistency-distillation loss.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.summary: 用多头注意力组合序列信息，结合位置编码、逐位置前馈网络和残差归一化构成 Transformer。
papers.summary_en: Combine sequence information through multi-head attention, positional encoding, position-wise feed-forward networks, and residual normalization.
papers.scope: 分别实现缩放点积注意力、多头注意力、LayerNorm 与 Add & Norm、正弦位置编码及逐位置前馈网络；每个模块独立练习，辅助代码与小实验已提供。
papers.scope_en: Independently implement scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, LayerNorm and Add & Norm, sinusoidal positional encoding, and position-wise feed-forward networks; helpers and small experiments are supplied.

papers.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
papers.summary: 将权重衰减与自适应梯度更新分离。
papers.summary_en: Decouple weight decay from the adaptive gradient update.
papers.scope: 实现矩估计、偏差修正与解耦权重衰减的一步更新。
papers.scope_en: Implement moment estimates, bias correction, and a decoupled weight-decay step.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.authors: Tri Dao, Daniel Y. Fu, Stefano Ermon, Atri Rudra, Christopher Ré
papers.summary: 利用在线 softmax 分块精确累积注意力，避免物化完整注意力矩阵。
papers.summary_en: Accumulate exact attention in blocks with online softmax without materializing the full attention matrix.
papers.scope: 实现分块递推与重缩放。这是 CPU 算法练习，不评价 GPU kernel 性能。
papers.scope_en: Implement blockwise recurrence and rescaling. This CPU algorithm exercise does not benchmark GPU kernels.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.summary: 用对称的批内对比损失对齐图像和文本表征。
papers.summary_en: Align image and text representations using a symmetric in-batch contrastive objective.
papers.scope: 实现特征归一化、温度缩放和双向对比损失，使用小型配对检索实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement feature normalization, temperature scaling, and bidirectional contrastive loss with a tiny paired-retrieval experiment.

papers.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
papers.summary: 从 GLM-5 技术报告中提取按注意力头正交化的优化更新，以及异步强化学习的重要性采样修正。
papers.summary_en: Extract head-wise orthogonalized updates and asynchronous-RL importance corrections from the GLM-5 technical report.
papers.scope: 两题分别实现 Muon Split 的逐头正交化与双边重要性采样策略损失，使用可复现的 CPU 教学实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement Muon Split's per-head orthogonalization and a double-sided importance-sampling policy loss in two independent CPU exercises.

papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
papers.summary: 实现 Kimi K3 在序列、深度和激活值三个维度的核心机制：KDA、块级注意力残差与 SiTU-GLU。
papers.summary_en: Implement Kimi K3's core mechanisms for sequence mixing, depth aggregation, and bounded activations: KDA, Block AttnRes, and SiTU-GLU.
papers.scope: 三题分别实现有界衰减与 delta-rule 递推、跨层残差注意力聚合、SiTU 门控激活，并重绘论文中的门函数与激活曲线。
papers.scope_en: Independently implement bounded decay and delta-rule recurrence, attention over residual blocks, and SiTU gating; recreate the report's decay and activation curves.

papers.title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.summary: 用同一模型的特权上下文教师监督学生自己的轨迹。
papers.summary_en: Use a privileged-context teacher from the same model to supervise student rollouts.
papers.scope: 双上下文因果对齐与逐词表项散度截断。
papers.scope_en: Dual-context causal alignment and pointwise divergence clipping.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation
papers.summary: 将环境反馈与成功尝试转成逐 token 的自蒸馏监督。
papers.summary_en: Turn environment feedback and successful attempts into token-level self-distillation.
papers.scope: 同题反馈路由、reverse KL 与 top-k 尾部概率聚合。
papers.scope_en: Same-question feedback routing, reverse KL, and top-k tail-mass coarsening.

papers.title: Representation Alignment for Generation: Training Diffusion Transformers Is Easier Than You Think
papers.summary: 将生成模型的中间特征与冻结教师的语义表征对齐。
papers.summary_en: Align intermediate generative features with a frozen semantic teacher.
papers.scope: 逐 patch 表征对齐损失与梯度边界。
papers.scope_en: Patch-wise representation alignment and gradient boundaries.

papers.title: Restructuring Vector Quantization with the Rotation Trick
papers.summary: 以冻结旋转与缩放构造向量量化的代理梯度。
papers.summary_en: Use a frozen rotation and scale to construct vector-quantization surrogate gradients.
papers.scope: 保持量化前向值的旋转梯度变换。
papers.scope_en: Rotation-based gradient transformation with quantized forward values.

papers.title: Differential Transformer
papers.summary: 相减两张注意力图以抑制共有噪声。
papers.summary_en: Subtract two attention maps to suppress common-mode noise.
papers.scope: 已投影张量上的差分注意力与 lambda 参数化。
papers.scope_en: Differential attention on projected tensors and lambda parameterization.

papers.title: Block Diffusion: Interpolating Between Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: 以块间自回归和块内扩散结合离散生成。
papers.summary_en: Combine autoregression across blocks with diffusion within blocks.
papers.scope: 拼接干净和含噪 token 的单次前向注意力掩码。
papers.scope_en: Single-forward attention masks for concatenated noisy and clean tokens.

papers.title: DistiLLM-2: A Contrastive Approach Boosts the Distillation of LLMs
papers.summary: 在教师与学生生成的数据上分别使用不同的蒸馏方向。
papers.summary_en: Use distinct distillation directions on teacher- and student-generated responses.
papers.scope: 教师轨迹的 skew KL 与学生轨迹的 skew reverse KL。
papers.scope_en: Skew KL on teacher trajectories and skew reverse KL on student trajectories.

papers.title: Pass@K Policy Optimization: Solving Harder Reinforcement Learning Problems
papers.summary: 将 pass@k 目标的奖励变换用于策略梯度训练。
papers.summary_en: Transform rewards to optimize a pass@k policy-gradient objective.
papers.scope: 连续奖励变换、policy loss 与论文的一维 Gaussian toy。
papers.scope_en: Continuous-reward transformation, policy loss, and the paper’s one-dimensional Gaussian toy.

papers.title: SVDQuant: Absorbing Outliers by Low-Rank Components for 4-Bit Diffusion Models
papers.summary: 用高精度低秩支路吸收量化困难成分，再量化残差。
papers.summary_en: Absorb difficult-to-quantize components in a high-precision low-rank branch and quantize the residual.
papers.scope: 平滑、SVD 低秩分解与 4-bit 残差前向。
papers.scope_en: Smoothing, SVD low-rank decomposition, and a 4-bit residual forward pass.

papers.title: MoGe: Unlocking Accurate Monocular Geometry Estimation for Open-Domain Images with Optimal Training Supervision
papers.summary: 通过鲁棒几何对齐处理单目预测中的尺度与深度偏移。
papers.summary_en: Use robust geometric alignment to handle scale and depth-shift ambiguity in monocular predictions.
papers.scope: 截断加权 L1 的鲁棒最优估计。
papers.scope_en: Robust optimal estimation with truncated weighted L1 residuals.

papers.title: Improving Diffusion Inverse Problem Solving with Decoupled Noise Annealing
papers.summary: 将干净空间的测量一致性优化与重新加噪解耦。
papers.summary_en: Decouple measurement-consistency updates in clean space from renoising.
papers.scope: 线性 Gaussian 后验 score、Langevin 与独立重新加噪。
papers.scope_en: Linear-Gaussian posterior score, Langevin updates, and independent renoising.

papers.title: DiffusionNFT: Online Diffusion Reinforcement with Forward Process
papers.summary: 从反馈构造正负隐式速度场，优化扩散模型。
papers.summary_en: Construct positive and negative implicit velocity fields from feedback to optimize diffusion models.
papers.scope: 正负 beta 隐式速度、双分支目标与微型训练。
papers.scope_en: Positive/negative beta implicit velocities, the two-branch objective, and tiny training.

papers.title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
papers.summary: 按从粗到细的尺度顺序生成视觉 token，并在同一尺度内并行预测。
papers.summary_en: Generate visual tokens from coarse to fine, predicting tokens within each scale in parallel.
papers.scope: 下一尺度的条件输入与注意力掩码，以及多尺度残差量化与重建。
papers.scope_en: Next-scale conditioning and attention masks, plus multiscale residual quantization and reconstruction.

papers.title: Representation Fréchet Loss for Visual Generation
papers.authors: Jiawei Yang, Zhengyang Geng, Xuan Ju, Yonglong Tian, Yue Wang
papers.summary: 以历史特征统计估计更大的样本总体，只对当前 batch 反传 Fréchet 距离。
papers.summary_en: Estimate a larger feature population from historical statistics while backpropagating Fréchet distance through the current batch only.
papers.scope: 原始一阶与二阶矩的 EMA、协方差恢复、可微 Fréchet 距离和多表征损失归一化。
papers.scope_en: EMA of raw first and second moments, covariance recovery, differentiable Fréchet distance, and multi-representation loss normalization.

papers.title: VICReg: Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning
papers.authors: Adrien Bardes, Jean Ponce, Yann LeCun
papers.summary: 用方差、视图一致性与去相关约束学习表征。
papers.summary_en: Learn representations with variance, view invariance, and decorrelation constraints.
papers.scope: 三项损失的批统计、权重与梯度。
papers.scope_en: Batch statistics, weights, and gradients of the three loss terms.

papers.title: LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics
papers.summary: 用随机投影上的高斯性约束学习各向同性表征。
papers.summary_en: Learn isotropic representations with Gaussianity constraints on random projections.
papers.scope: SIGReg 的特征函数检验、数值积分与切片聚合。
papers.scope_en: SIGReg characteristic-function statistics, numerical integration, and slice aggregation.

papers.title: VISReg: Variance-Invariance-Sketching Regularization for JEPA training
papers.authors: Haiyu Wu, Randall Balestriero, Morgan Levine
papers.summary: 分离表征的尺度与分布形状，用切片匹配约束高斯性。
papers.summary_en: Separate representation scale and distribution shape with sliced Gaussian matching.
papers.scope: 尺度、切片形状、中心与多视图一致性损失。
papers.scope_en: Scale, sliced shape, centering, and multi-view invariance losses.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning from Images with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.authors: Mahmoud Assran, Quentin Duval, Ishan Misra, Piotr Bojanowski, Pascal Vincent, Michael Rabbat, Yann LeCun, Nicolas Ballas
papers.summary: 从上下文预测被遮挡图像块的教师表征。
papers.summary_en: Predict teacher representations of masked image blocks from context.
papers.scope: 目标块提取、预测损失与 EMA 教师更新。
papers.scope_en: Target-block gathering, prediction loss, and EMA teacher updates.

papers.title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
papers.authors: Lucas Maes, Quentin Le Lidec, Damien Scieur, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero
papers.summary: 联合学习动作条件潜空间预测，并用潜空间 rollout 规划动作。
papers.summary_en: Jointly learn action-conditioned latent predictions and plan actions with latent rollouts.
papers.scope: 可微预测与正则目标、自回归 rollout、终点代价和 CEM 精英重拟合。
papers.scope_en: Differentiable prediction and regularization, autoregressive rollout, terminal cost, and CEM elite refitting.

papers.title: Causal-JEPA: Learning World Models through Object-Level Latent Masking
papers.authors: Heejeong Nam, Quentin Le Lidec, Lucas Maes, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero
papers.summary: 遮挡对象的潜空间轨迹，让模型从其他对象推断其动态。
papers.summary_en: Mask object-level latent trajectories to infer their dynamics from other objects.
papers.scope: 保留初始身份锚点的对象遮挡与历史、未来预测损失。
papers.scope_en: Object masking with initial identity anchors and history/future prediction losses.

papers.title: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization
papers.summary: 用均方根代替去均值的归一化，并研究部分特征统计。
papers.summary_en: Normalize by root mean square without centering and explore partial feature statistics.
papers.scope: 实现 RMSNorm 和前 k 特征的 pRMSNorm，检查尺度关系与跨特征梯度。
papers.scope_en: Implement RMSNorm and first-k pRMSNorm; check scale identities and cross-feature gradients.

module.goal_en: Implement the linear conditional path, target velocity, and conditional Flow Matching loss.
module.scope: 实现 interpolate、cfm_target 和 cfm_loss；时间采样、Euler 求解器和测试训练循环已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement interpolate, cfm_target, and cfm_loss. Time sampling, the Euler solver, and the test training loop are provided.

problems.title: GSPO 序列比率与截断

module.goal: 实现序列重要性比率和截断策略损失。
module.goal_en: Implement the sequence importance ratio and clipped policy loss.
module.scope: 只实现两个函数；组 advantage 计算、采样和分布式 RL 不属于本模块。
module.scope_en: Two functions; group advantages, sampling and distributed RL are outside this module.

problems.title: 学生前缀上的 On-policy Distillation

module.goal: 从学生分布采样，在相同前缀上蒸馏教师全词表反馈。
module.goal_en: Sample from the student and distill full-vocabulary feedback at the same prefixes.
module.scope: 选取 GKD 的 lambda=1 与明确方向的 KL；提供三 token Markov 语言模型代替大型语言模型。
module.scope_en: GKD with lambda=1 and explicit forward/reverse KL; a supplied three-token Markov LM replaces large language models.

problems.title: DAPO 动态筛选与 Token 目标

module.goal: 筛选有效组，实现非对称的按 token 归一化截断目标。
module.goal_en: Retain informative groups and implement asymmetric token-normalized clipping.
module.scope: 两个有界核心函数；不复现超采样调度、超长奖励整形和分布式训练。
module.scope_en: Two bounded core functions. Oversampling orchestration, overlong reward shaping, and distributed training are not reproduced.

en.title: DAPO Dynamic Filtering and Token Objective

problems.title: LoRA 低秩更新与冻结基座前向

module.goal: 实现缩放低秩更新并冻结基座参数。
module.goal_en: Implement a scaled low-rank update while freezing base parameters.
module.scope: 实现线性层的两个函数；初始化与 rank-2 回归训练循环已提供。
module.scope_en: Two functions for a linear layer; initialization and a rank-two regression training loop are provided.

en.title: LoRA Low-rank Updates and Frozen-base Forward

problems.title: QLoRA NF4 分块与可训练 Adapter

module.goal: 实现分块 NF4 量化，在冻结量化基座上训练 adapter。
module.goal_en: Implement block NF4 quantization and train adapters through a frozen quantized base.
module.scope: 三个 CPU 函数；索引用未打包 uint8 便于观察，不包含 4-bit 打包存储、双重量化和分页优化器。
module.scope_en: Three CPU functions. Code indices are unpacked uint8 for inspectability; packed 4-bit storage, double quantization and paged optimizers are outside scope.

en.title: QLoRA NF4 Blocks and Trainable Adapters

problems.title: MeanFlow：平均速度与 JVP 目标

module.goal: 实现平均速度的全导数目标、冻结目标损失，以及一次前向采样。
module.goal_en: Implement the total-derivative average-velocity target and its frozen-target loss, then sample in one call.
module.scope: 实现 meanflow_target, meanflow_loss, one_step；toy.py 提供训练与可视化脚手架。
module.scope_en: Implement meanflow_target, meanflow_loss, one_step. toy.py provides the training and visualization scaffold.

en.title: MeanFlow: Average Velocity and JVP Targets

problems.title: JiT：高维空间中的干净数据预测

module.goal: 实现干净数据预测与速度空间监督，在高维嵌入数据上比较 x/epsilon/v 输出。
module.goal_en: Implement clean-data prediction with velocity-space supervision and compare x/epsilon/v outputs on embedded data.
module.scope: 实现 make_noisy, prediction_to_velocity, velocity_loss；toy.py 提供训练与可视化脚手架。
module.scope_en: Implement make_noisy, prediction_to_velocity, velocity_loss. toy.py provides the training and visualization scaffold.

en.title: JiT: Clean Prediction in High Dimensions

problems.title: Drifting：成对漂移场与冻结目标

module.goal: 实现距离核漂移场及 stop-gradient 目标，训练一次前向即可采样的生成器。
module.goal_en: Implement the distance-kernel drifting field and its stop-gradient target; train a generator with one-pass inference.
module.scope: 实现 drift_field, drifting_loss；toy.py 提供训练与可视化脚手架。
module.scope_en: Implement drift_field, drifting_loss. toy.py provides the training and visualization scaffold.

en.title: Drifting: Pairwise Field and Frozen Targets

problems.title: DMD：分数差分布蒸馏

module.goal: 实现分布匹配生成器梯度、配对回归与独立的 fake-score 更新。
module.goal_en: Implement the distribution-matching generator gradient, paired regression, and separate fake-score update.
module.scope: 实现 score_difference, dmd_loss, fake_score_loss；toy.py 提供训练与可视化脚手架。
module.scope_en: Implement score_difference, dmd_loss, fake_score_loss. toy.py provides the training and visualization scaffold.

problems.title: DMD2：双时间尺度与对抗更新

module.goal: 在分布匹配基础上实现 critic/生成器更新比例和非饱和 GAN 项。
module.goal_en: Implement the critic-to-generator update ratio and non-saturating GAN contribution on top of distribution matching.
module.scope: 实现 generator_due, adversarial_losses, generator_loss；toy.py 提供训练与可视化脚手架。
module.scope_en: Implement generator_due, adversarial_losses, generator_loss. toy.py provides the training and visualization scaffold.

problems.title: Consistency Models：边界与教师目标

module.goal: 实现保持边界的 consistency 函数、冻结相邻时间目标的损失与 EMA 更新。
module.goal_en: Implement a boundary-preserving consistency function, stop-gradient pair loss, and EMA target update.
module.scope: 实现 consistency_function, consistency_loss, update_ema；toy.py 提供训练与可视化脚手架。
module.scope_en: Implement consistency_function, consistency_loss, update_ema. toy.py provides the training and visualization scaffold.

en.title: Consistency Models: Boundary and Teacher Targets

problems.title: 缩放点积注意力

module.goal: 实现多头布局下的缩放点积注意力及可见性掩码。
module.goal_en: Implement scaled dot-product attention and visibility masking with a multi-head tensor layout.
module.scope: 只实现 scaled_dot_product_attention；causal_mask 和前缀平均实验已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement only scaled_dot_product_attention; causal_mask and the prefix-average experiment are provided.

problems.title: 解耦 AdamW 更新

module.goal: 实现带偏差校正和解耦权重衰减的一步 AdamW 更新。
module.goal_en: Implement one AdamW step with bias correction and decoupled weight decay.
module.scope: 只实现 adamw_step；状态初始化与二维优化实验已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement only adamw_step; state initialization and the two-dimensional optimization experiment are provided.

problems.title: 在线 Softmax 与分块注意力

module.goal: 用在线 softmax 合并 score 分块，得到精确 attention 和 log-sum-exp。
module.goal_en: Merge score tiles with online softmax to recover exact attention and log-sum-exp.
module.scope: 只实现 online_softmax_update；双向分块遍历与最终归一化已提供。CPU 教学实现不复现 GPU 加速。
module.scope_en: Implement only online_softmax_update; query/key tiling and final normalization are supplied. This CPU teaching implementation does not reproduce GPU acceleration.

problems.title: 对称对比学习

module.goal: 实现特征归一化、可学习温度和双向图文对比损失。
module.goal_en: Implement feature normalization, learnable temperature, and the symmetric image-text contrastive objective.
module.scope: 实现 contrastive_logits 与 clip_loss；配对向量训练循环已提供，不训练完整图文编码器。
module.scope_en: Implement contrastive_logits and clip_loss; paired-vector training is provided, without training full image/text encoders.

problems.title: Progressive Distillation：教师两步压成学生一步

module.goal: 求出使学生一步 DDIM 精确匹配教师两步的干净数据目标，并训练学生。
module.goal_en: Derive the exact clean prediction that makes one student DDIM step match two teacher steps, then learn it.
module.scope: 实现 ddim_step, distilled_target, distillation_loss；toy.py 提供训练与可视化脚手架。
module.scope_en: Implement ddim_step, distilled_target, distillation_loss. toy.py provides the training and visualization scaffold.

en.title: Progressive Distillation: Two Teacher Steps to One

problems.title: 多头注意力

module.goal: 将输入投影到多个子空间，分别执行注意力并拼接、输出投影。
module.goal_en: Project inputs into separate head subspaces, attend independently, concatenate, and output-project.
module.scope: 只实现 multi_head_attention；缩放点积注意力内核和双头路由实验已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement only multi_head_attention; the attention kernel and two-head routing experiment are supplied.

problems.title: LayerNorm 与残差连接

module.goal: 实现逐 token 的 LayerNorm 和原始 Transformer 的 Add & Norm。
module.goal_en: Implement token-local LayerNorm and the original Transformer's Add & Norm.
module.scope: 实现 layer_norm 和 post_norm_residual；子层输出与无训练 toy 实验已提供，关闭 dropout。
module.scope_en: Implement layer_norm and post_norm_residual; sublayer outputs and the training-free toy are supplied, with dropout disabled.

problems.title: 正弦位置编码

module.goal: 实现不同频率的正弦/余弦位置编码。
module.goal_en: Implement paired sine/cosine position features at geometrically spaced frequencies.
module.scope: 只实现 sinusoidal_encoding；相对位移实验已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement only sinusoidal_encoding; the relative-offset experiment is provided.

problems.title: 逐位置前馈网络

module.goal: 实现每个 token 独立共享的两层 ReLU 前馈网络。
module.goal_en: Implement the shared two-layer ReLU network applied independently to each token.
module.scope: 只实现 positionwise_ffn；训练循环和数据已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement only positionwise_ffn; training and data are provided.

problems.title: Muon Split：逐头矩阵正交化

module.goal: 按注意力输出头拆分矩阵，各自求极分解因子后拼回。
module.goal_en: Split an attention projection matrix by output head, compute each polar factor, and merge.
module.scope: 只实现逐头正交化；使用精确 SVD 的教学近似，非完整 Muon 优化器或 GLM 训练。
module.scope_en: Implement only head-wise orthogonalization, using an exact-SVD teaching model; not the full Muon optimizer or GLM training.

problems.title: GLM-5：异步 RL 的双边重要性采样

module.goal: 计算双边区间内的重要性权重，实现冻结权重的 token 级策略梯度目标。
module.goal_en: Compute double-sided masked importance weights and a detached-weight token-level policy-gradient objective.
module.scope: 两个数值函数；原文严格边界加显式 stop-gradient 约定，不复现异步调度与代码智能体。
module.scope_en: Two numerical functions with the report’s strict boundaries and an explicit stop-gradient convention; no asynchronous scheduler or coding agent.

problems.title: Kimi K3：有界衰减与 Delta 记忆

module.goal: 实现逐通道遗忘与 delta-rule 写入，理解 K3 如何更新和读取有限状态记忆。
module.goal_en: Implement channel-wise retention and delta-rule writes, then read the updated recurrent memory.
module.scope: 只实现 bounded_decay 和 recurrent_kda；投影、卷积、输出门和 GPU kernel 不在本题范围。
module.scope_en: Implement bounded_decay and recurrent_kda only; projections, convolutions, output gates and GPU kernels are outside this exercise.

en.title: Kimi K3: Bounded Decay and Delta Memory

problems.title: Kimi K3：Block Attention Residuals

module.goal: 组装深度来源，让可学习查询选择早期层表示，并聚合未经归一化的原值。
module.goal_en: Assemble depth sources, select earlier representations with a learned query, and aggregate original values.
module.scope: 只实现 assemble_sources 与 depth_attention；完整 Transformer、残差块累加与层投影由外部提供。
module.scope_en: Implement assemble_sources and depth_attention; the full Transformer, block accumulation and layer projections are external.

problems.title: SiTU-GLU 平滑有界激活

module.goal: 平滑限制门控与 up 分支，在保留局部 SwiGLU 行为的同时控制异常激活。
module.goal_en: Smoothly cap both activation branches while retaining local SwiGLU behavior.
module.scope: 只实现 softcap 和已投影张量上的 SiTU-GLU；不实现 MoE 路由或完整 FFN。
module.scope_en: Implement softcap and SiTU-GLU on projected tensors; MoE routing and the full FFN are outside this module.

problems.title: OPSD 学生轨迹的双上下文对齐

module.goal: 对齐同一段学生回答在不同长度上下文下的 next-token logits。
module.goal_en: Align next-token logits for the same student response under unequal context lengths.
module.scope: 实现因果位置选择、变长掩码和教师梯度隔离；logits 与 toy 训练循环已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement causal position selection, variable-length masking, and teacher detachment; logits and a toy training loop are supplied.

problems.title: OPSD 逐词表项散度截断

module.goal: 实现 forward/reverse KL 的逐词表项上限截断。
module.goal_en: Upper-clip vocabulary contributions to forward and reverse KL.
module.scope: 实现有符号散度项、逐项截断和回答级平均；阈值校验与实验循环已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement signed divergence terms, pointwise clipping, and response-level averaging; validation and experiments are supplied.

problems.title: SDPO 反馈选择与自蒸馏

module.goal: 按 Table 2 选择自身成功解、同题成功解或环境反馈，再执行自蒸馏。
module.goal_en: Select a successful self/peer solution or environment feedback following Table 2, then distill.
module.scope: 实现反馈路由与有效 token 的 reverse KL；微型程序和 categorical 教师已提供，同题多解时取最小索引。
module.scope_en: Implement feedback routing and token-masked reverse KL; tiny programs and a categorical teacher are supplied. Choose the lowest index among multiple peer solutions.

problems.title: SDPO Top-K 与尾部概率散度

module.goal: 将词表压缩成学生 top-k 项和一个尾部桶，保留分布的总概率质量。
module.goal_en: Coarsen the vocabulary into student top-k entries and one tail bin while preserving total probability mass.
module.scope: 实现 top-k 选择、尾部 logsumexp 和 reverse KL；测试与信息损失曲线已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement top-k selection, complementary logsumexp, and reverse KL; tests and information curves are supplied.

problems.title: REPA 表征对齐损失

module.goal: 将扩散模型的噪声特征逐 patch 对齐到冻结的干净图像教师表征。
module.goal_en: Align noisy diffusion features patch by patch to frozen clean-image representations.
module.scope: 实现对齐损失和总目标；提供已投影特征，不训练完整 DiT 或教师编码器。
module.scope_en: Implement alignment and the combined objective on projected features; full DiT and teacher training are outside this module.

problems.title: Rotation Trick 向量量化梯度

module.goal: 在量化前向保持码本值，同时通过冻结的旋转与缩放传递梯度。
module.goal_en: Keep the quantized forward value while transporting encoder gradients through a frozen scaled rotation.
module.scope: 输入已选好的码本向量，仅实现梯度替代器；不实现码本学习或完整 VQ-VAE。
module.scope_en: Given the selected code, implement the gradient surrogate; codebook learning and a full VQ-VAE are outside this module.

problems.title: Differential Transformer 差分注意力

module.goal: 用两张注意力图的差分抵消共有响应，并正确传播可学习 lambda 的梯度。
module.goal_en: Subtract two attention maps to cancel shared responses and propagate gradients through a learned lambda.
module.scope: 实现已投影 Q/K/V 的差分注意力与 lambda；每头归一化、输出投影和整个语言模型不在本题范围。
module.scope_en: Implement projected differential attention and lambda; per-head normalization, output projection and the full language model are outside this module.

problems.title: Block Diffusion 分块注意力

module.goal: 用一次注意力前向同时处理各噪声块与干净上下文，阻止目标泄漏。
module.goal_en: Process noisy blocks and clean context in one attention pass without leaking clean targets.
module.scope: 实现训练期的专用掩码及稠密注意力；不实现离散扩散采样、NELBO 或 KV cache。
module.scope_en: Implement the specialized training mask and dense attention; discrete diffusion sampling, NELBO and KV caching are outside this module.

problems.title: DistiLLM-2 双源非对称蒸馏

module.goal: 实现教师回答的 SKL、学生回答的 SRKL 和 Eq.2 配对损失。
module.goal_en: Implement teacher-response SKL, student-response SRKL and the paired Eq.2 loss.
module.scope: 固定系数、全词表条件分布；响应已提供，保留 1/(2B) 归约。
module.scope_en: Fixed coefficients and full conditional vocabularies; responses are supplied, retaining the 1/(2B) reduction.

problems.title: PKPO 奖励变换与无偏策略梯度

module.goal: 实现期望最大值及 sloo-minus-one 无偏策略梯度。
module.goal_en: Implement expected maximum and the sloo-minus-one policy gradient.
module.scope: 已采样动作与 log-prob；包含连续奖励及 k=1 约定，不训练语言模型。
module.scope_en: Supplied actions and log probabilities; continuous rewards and an explicit k=1 convention, without LLM training.

en.title: PKPO Reward Transform and Unbiased Policy Gradient

problems.title: SVDQuant 平滑、低秩与残差量化

module.goal: 实现平滑、截断 SVD 和低精度残差双分支前向。
module.goal_en: Implement smoothing, truncated SVD and a quantized residual two-branch forward.
module.scope: 给定平滑系数及 INT fake quantizer；单次 SVD，无校准搜索、FP4、迭代细化或 GPU 内核。
module.scope_en: Given smoothing factors and an INT fake quantizer; one SVD, no calibration search, FP4, iterative refinement or GPU kernels.

en.title: SVDQuant Smoothing, Low-rank and Residual Quantization

problems.title: MoGe 鲁棒最优对齐

module.goal: 通过加权 L1 折点与深度锚点，精确求解相机坐标点图的尺度及 z 平移。
module.goal_en: Solve shared scale and z translation exactly using weighted L1 breakpoints and depth anchors.
module.scope: 实现 ROE 的全局对齐核心；CPU 小点集枚举，不包含点图网络、多尺度球域或相机恢复。
module.scope_en: Implement the global ROE alignment core on tiny point sets; exclude the point-map network, multi-scale spheres and camera recovery.

problems.title: DAPS 解耦后验采样

module.goal: 用观测条件 score 做 Langevin 更新，再从干净样本独立加噪进入下一噪声层。
module.goal_en: Use a measurement-conditioned score for Langevin updates, then independently re-noise the clean sample.
module.scope: 实现线性观测下的 DAPS Eq.(7) 内核和重加噪。ODE 输出、噪声、循环由脚手架提供；不训练扩散网络。
module.scope_en: Implement DAPS Eq. (7) for a linear observation and the re-noising kernel. ODE estimates, noises and the loop are supplied; no diffusion network training.

problems.title: DiffusionNFT 正负双分支流匹配

module.goal: 从单个可训练 velocity 构造隐式正负策略，并通过概率奖励联合优化。
module.goal_en: Construct implicit positive and negative policies from one trainable velocity and optimize both with probabilistic rewards.
module.scope: 实现 Eq.(5) 训练核心；提供前向加噪与微型训练脚手架，不包含图像奖励模型、在线采样或 EMA 更新。
module.scope_en: Implement the Eq. (5) training core; forward noising and tiny training scaffolding are supplied. Image reward models, online rollouts and EMA updates are excluded.

en.title: DiffusionNFT Positive and Negative Flow Matching

problems.title: VAR 下一尺度预测

module.goal: 构造只依赖更低尺度 token 的输入，以及尺度内双向、尺度间因果的可见性矩阵。
module.goal_en: Build lower-scale teacher inputs and a scale-causal visibility matrix.
module.scope: 冻结 tokenizer，插值与投影 helper 已提供；仅实现输入构造和 mask，不训练完整 Transformer。
module.scope_en: Frozen tokenizer helpers are provided; implement teacher inputs and masking, without a full Transformer.

problems.title: VAR 多尺度残差量化

module.goal: 从粗到细量化剩余特征，并在最大分辨率累计重建。
module.goal_en: Quantize residual features from coarse to fine and accumulate full-resolution reconstructions.
module.scope: 给定编码特征、共享码本与尺度投影，仅实现冻结 tokenizer 的编码和解码；不训练 VQ-VAE。
module.scope_en: Given features, a shared codebook and scale projections, implement frozen tokenizer encoding and decoding; VQ-VAE training is outside scope.

problems.title: FD-loss 总体矩与 EMA

module.goal: 通过原始一阶、二阶矩保留总体信息，只让当前微批次接收梯度。
module.goal_en: Track population information through raw first and second moments while differentiating only the current microbatch.
module.scope: 实现论文默认 EMA 统计估计器；提供确定性特征流。FIFO 队列、多 GPU、图像特征提取与生成器不在本题范围内。
module.scope_en: Implement the default EMA statistics estimator with a supplied deterministic feature stream. FIFO queues, multiple GPUs, image feature extraction and a generator are outside this module.

problems.title: FD-loss 可微 Fréchet 损失

module.goal: 对总体高斯统计计算可微 Fréchet 距离，并实现停止分母梯度的表征损失归一化。
module.goal_en: Differentiate Gaussian population Fréchet distance and normalize representation losses with a stopped denominator.
module.scope: 实现 Eq.(2)、Eq.(6) 与附录 B.3 的对称矩阵迹算法；提供 EMA、二维生成器和优化循环，不训练图像表征网络。
module.scope_en: Implement Eq. (2), Eq. (6), and the symmetric trace algorithm from Appendix B.3. EMA, the 2D generator and the optimizer loop are provided; no image representation model is trained.

problems.title: VICReg 方差、不变性与协方差

module.goal: 实现显式防塌缩与去冗余目标，区分方差下界和协方差惩罚。
module.goal_en: Implement an explicit anti-collapse and redundancy objective, separating a variance floor from covariance penalties.
module.scope: 只实现两视图特征上的三个标量项与加权目标；编码器、投影头与分布式特征收集由题目范围排除。

problems.title: LeJEPA 切片高斯正则 SIGReg

module.scope: 聚合成功与失败的渲染反馈，计算提案奖励和多样性调整。
module.scope_en: Aggregate successful and failed render feedback with proposal and diversity rewards.

problems.title: Diffusion Policy 动作去噪与滚动执行

module.goal: 实现动作序列的前向加噪、条件噪声预测损失，以及与最后一帧观测对齐的执行片段。
module.goal_en: Implement action-sequence noising, the conditional epsilon loss and execution chunks aligned with the last observation.
module.scope: 选取动作扩散训练与滚动执行核心；提供条件去噪小实验，不包含视觉编码器、完整反向采样器或机器人仿真。
module.scope_en: Implement the action diffusion training and receding-horizon core; a conditional denoising experiment is supplied. Vision encoders, full reverse sampling and robot simulation are outside this module.

en.title: Diffusion Policy Action Denoising and Receding-Horizon Execution

problems.title: SuperMimic 可微想象回报与价值目标

module.goal: 通过可微存活概率累积短时想象回报，并为 critic 构造冻结的 λ-return 目标。
module.goal_en: Accumulate short imagined returns through differentiable survival probabilities and construct frozen lambda-return critic targets.
module.scope: 实现论文 Eq.(2) 和 Eq.(3) 的回报核心；小实验通过固定一维动力学学习反馈策略，不涉及人形机器人仿真、数据收集或世界模型拟合。
module.scope_en: Implement the return core of Eq. (2) and Eq. (3); a tiny policy learns through fixed 1D dynamics. Humanoid simulation, replay collection and world-model fitting are outside this exercise.

en.title: SuperMimic Differentiable Imagination Returns and Critic Targets

problems.title: Diffusion-DPO 成对去噪偏好优化

module.goal: 共享偏好对的噪声，并相对冻结参考模型优化去噪误差差值。
module.goal_en: Share noise within each preference pair and optimize denoising error gaps against a frozen reference.
module.scope: 实现成对前向加噪与稳定 Diffusion-DPO 损失，训练两参数去噪器；使用官方实现的特征均值与 beta/2 约定。
module.scope_en: Implement paired forward noising and stable Diffusion-DPO loss, then train a two-parameter denoiser using the official feature-mean and beta/2 convention.

problems.title: Flow-GRPO 随机流转移与组相对策略优化

module.goal: 将 rectified flow 变为可计算概率的随机高斯转移，再按组奖励优化策略。
module.goal_en: Convert rectified flow into stochastic Gaussian transitions with tractable densities and optimize them using group rewards.
module.scope: 实现反向时间的 SDE 均值与方差、按 prompt 归一化奖励、逐转移截断目标和精确高斯 KL；提供小型在线 rollout 训练。
module.scope_en: Implement reverse-time SDE statistics, per-prompt reward normalization, per-transition clipping and exact Gaussian KL with a tiny online rollout experiment.

en.title: Flow-GRPO Stochastic Flow Transitions and Group-Relative Updates

problems.title: SigLIP 图文成对 Sigmoid 对齐

module.goal: 实现归一化图文相似度与成对 sigmoid 目标，训练匹配关系。
module.goal_en: Implement normalized image-text similarities and the pairwise sigmoid objective to learn matching pairs.
module.scope: 逐行 L2 归一化、可学习温度与偏置、按 batch 归约的稳定损失，以及四对合成向量训练。
module.scope_en: Row-wise L2 normalization, learnable scale and bias, stable batch-normalized loss, and training on four synthetic pairs.

problems.title: PagedAttention 分页 KV 缓存与解码注意力

module.goal: 通过逻辑块表访问离散的 KV 物理页，并保持与连续注意力相同的结果。
module.goal_en: Read scattered physical KV pages through logical block tables while preserving dense-attention results.
module.scope: 分页索引、共享前缀、尾页长度与多头单步注意力的 CPU 规格实现；提供解码回放和存储槽计数。
module.scope_en: A CPU specification of page indexing, shared prefixes, partial tails and multihead decode attention, with replay and slot accounting.

en.title: PagedAttention KV Pages and Decode Attention
